note: $2,000 plan: 70% core beta / 20% ETF rotation / 10% paper sandbox. Only buy_hold sleeves are enabled here; signal sleeves are added with their own pre-registered rules.

sleeves.thesis: Top-5 long-only asset-class ETFs by 9-month (189d) momentum, monthly, absolute filter (negative momentum -> cash). Universe = the 14 liquid asset-class ETFs studied in reports/TACTICAL_ROTATION_EDGE_2026-07-04.md. LAG-CORRECTED evidence for THIS exact universe and 9-month rule (copilot PR #964): lag-1d Sharpe 0.81, MaxDD -14.6% vs SPY 0.69 / -52.9% over 2007+; CAGR still trails SPY. Unlagged and 6-month results are DIFFERENT configurations and are not quoted as this sleeve's evidence. Drawdown control, not excess return. Forward n=0.
Control arm: 3 pseudo-random sector ETFs on the same rebalance dates. If etf-rotation cannot beat this, its momentum selection adds nothing.
